member: Sam — Structure, Mass and Material Handling Engineer
message:
Mara, Theo and Priya, rear lift uses fixed path with friction counted. Hopper pivot starts at 0.45 metres and rises on 0.60 metre guide to 1.05 metre pour lip, driven by 0.15 metre stroke dual actuators through 4-to-1 chain at 0.80 efficiency. Need 735 newton total per actuator force calc (E41), about one adult weight, with 110 joule input per stroke work calc (E42) versus 88.3 joule useful per useful energy calc (E38), confirmed by recompute check (E47). Old 2400 joule discarded as motor timing not weight times rise, which is why recompute differs.

Raised load stays nose down. Fifteen kilogram load at 0.30 metre overhang aft of rear axle on 0.70 metre wheelbase leaves 16.9 kilogram front residual per residual mass calc (E40) for factor 4.66 per moment calc (E43), like wheelbarrow. 7.1 versus 4.06 split reconciles as arm change from no overhang to long overhang; 4.66 uses 0.30 metre overhang.

Stow and mass reuse closed evidence. 0.95 metre frame with 300 millimetre wheels, mast folded to 0.45 metre and lowered hopper fits 1.0 by 0.5 by 0.5 metre box per stowed and deployed sketch (E48), reusing stowed sketch (E44) with deployed pour added. 171 Watt-hour sortie per sortie energy calc (E32) at 90.6 Watt-hour per kilogram per pack density calc (E34) gives 53.0 kilogram total per reconciled mass calc (E37) under 60 kilogram limit, like luggage. I am ready because lift, tip and stow close with reconciled mass.
